en.headline: Planning Department delays Sai Kung dog shelter shutdown by three months
en.dek: Enforcement against an unauthorised animal boarding use at Ho Chung is suspended until 12 December after the operator lodged a planning application.
body: The Planning Department said it would suspend enforcement action against an animal shelter in Sai Kung’s Ho Chung area and extend the compliance deadline on a statutory notice by three months, to 12 December, after the operator applied for temporary planning permission.

In a statement posted on Friday, the department said inspections in February and April established that about 1,900 square metres on the eastern part of the site at Tai Lam Wu Road was being used as an animal boarding establishment. The land falls within a Conservation Area, where that use is not permitted without approval from the Town Planning Board.

A planning supervisor issued an enforcement notice on 12 June requiring the operator and landowners to stop the unauthorised use by 12 September. The operator, Sai Kung Stray Friends Foundation, submitted application A/SK-HC/379 on 19 August seeking a three-year temporary animal boarding facility. The Town Planning Board is still processing the application, and public comments are being accepted until 18 September.

The department said the operator provided further information on 11 September describing the practical difficulty of an immediate shutdown and the time needed to rehouse animals if permission is refused. Taking a pragmatic view of those circumstances, officials decided to hold the enforcement action and to offer planning advice to the applicant.

The shelter, founded about 15 years ago by Narelle Pamuk, houses more than 200 dogs. About 70 animals occupy the portion of the site covered by the notice. The Lands Department has said that if planning permission is later granted, it would consider regularising the land use through a short-term waiver and short-term tenancy.

zh.headline: 規劃署暫緩西貢狗舍執法 中止期限延至12月12日
zh.dek: 西貢蠅涌大藍湖路狗舍被指在自然保育區作動物寄養屬違例發展，署方因應規劃申請將強制執行通知書期限延長三個月。
body: 規劃署周五表示，體恤西貢蠅涌一所狗舍的獨特情況，決定暫緩執法，並將強制執行通知書的遵辦期限延長三個月，至今年12月12日。
署方指，今年2月及4月兩次實地視察後確定，大藍湖路用地東面約1,900平方米被用作「動物寄養所」。該地屬「自然保育區」地帶，有關用途並非准許用途，亦未獲城市規劃委員會批給規劃許可，構成《城市規劃條例》下的違例發展。
規劃監督已於6月12日向經營者及相關土地擁有人發出強制執行通知書，要求在9月12日或之前中止有關用途。經營者西貢流浪狗協會其後於8月19日向城規會提交申請（編號A/SK-HC/379），擬把用地改作三年期臨時動物寄養所，城規會正處理申請，公眾諮詢期至9月18日。
規劃署稱，經營者於9月11日提供最新資料，說明即時中止違例發展的實際困難，以及若最終不獲許可，需要更多時間安置受影響動物或搬遷。署方因此採取務實態度暫緩執法，並會主動提供規劃意見。
該會由Narelle Pamuk約15年前成立，現時場內有逾200隻狗，受通知書影響的約70隻。地政總署回應查詢時表示，若規劃許可最終獲批，會考慮以短期豁免書及短期租約規範用地。
